games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which word completes the sentence: My name ___ Maya.
rounds.explanation: My name is one thing, so we use is; are is for more than one and am only goes with I.

rounds.prompt: Which word completes the sentence: I ___ hop on one foot.
rounds.explanation: Can tells what you are able to do; is and are do not go with I hop, and the is not a doing word.

rounds.prompt: Which one is a complete sentence?
rounds.explanation: It starts with a capital letter, makes sense and ends with a full stop; the others are just groups of words.

rounds.prompt: Which word names a colour?
rounds.explanation: Blue is a colour; a bus is a vehicle, a farm is a place and hear is a sense word.

rounds.prompt: Which word names a person in a family?
rounds.explanation: Mum is a family member; the other words start with m too but they are a place, the sky and a thing.

rounds.prompt: Which word is an action you do in a ball game?
rounds.explanation: Bounce is an action with a ball; a hospital is a place, water is a liquid and a triangle is a shape.

games.description: Reveal tiles and connect each word with its meaning.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 1.
pairs: three
The number 3. It comes after two and before four.
please
Please is a kind word we use when we ask for something.
week
A week is seven days, from Monday to Sunday.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 2.
pairs: numbers
Numbers are words or signs like one, two and three that tell us how many.
favourite
Favourite means the one you like best.
choose
Choose means to pick the one you want.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 3.
pairs: saying
Saying means speaking words out loud.
finally
Finally means at last, after everything else is done.
apple
A round, crunchy fruit that is red or green.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 4.
pairs: see
To look at something and know it with your own eyes.
mum
A warm, friendly name that children use for their own mother.
bus
A long vehicle that carries many people to town.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 5.
pairs: throw
To send something through the air with your hand.
school
The building where you learn to read, write and count.
now
Now means at this moment, not later.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 6.
pairs: evening
The part of the day before night, when the sun sets.
tired
Tired means you need to rest or sleep.
welcome
Welcome is a friendly word you say to greet someone.
